Why this sleeve needs photos

    Fill the frame with the sleeve. Include all four corners, avoid glare, and keep catalogue numbers readable.

    Sequence and camera tips

    Every pair is the front followed by the back of the same sleeve. Return it to its original place, then move to the next highlighted sleeve.

    Some narrow edges may be folds of a neighboring jacket. If an entry is not a separate sleeve, skip the pair. You don’t need to photograph the same jacket twice. Guide numbers need not match the camera filenames.

    Photograph the closed outer cover. For a box set, photograph the outer box front and back. There’s no need to photograph the disc or gatefold inside in this pass.

    Use even daylight and hold your phone parallel to the cover. Check that small text is sharp. Leave the original camera filenames intact when you send the photos.

    If you retake a photo, keep both copies. I’ll match photos using their original order and cover contents, including any skipped folds.

    The numbered tags are sleeve positions in the original photos. The list below each map gives the camera photo numbers. Tap a sleeve or list entry to jump to its first photo.

    That’s the sequence.

    Send the original photos together. I’ll match them to the saved list, identify the remaining records, and replace the missing artwork.
